## edit.redo

Redoes the latest undone edit (not available while playing or while a scene is being opened). Fails when there is nothing to redo or the step no longer fits the project (e.g. a deleted asset's path now holds another one), saying why; such a step and the ones after it leave the history. Returns the history like edit.history.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorStateCommands.cpp:391`

No parameters.

## edit.undo

Undoes the latest edit of the scene or of the project's files (not available while playing or while a scene is being opened). Fails, changing nothing, when there is nothing to undo or the step cannot be undone now (e.g. another file is where a deleted asset would come back), saying why; the step stays in the history. Returns the history like edit.history.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorStateCommands.cpp:379`
